description:
According to UNESCO’s Atlas of the World’s Languages in Danger (https://unesdoc.unesco.org/ark:/48223/pf0000187026.), Inuktitut is one of approximately 2,500 languages at risk of disappearing worldwide. The Microsoft AI for Good Lab team is working to preserve low-resource languages, ensuring every voice has a place in the digital age.

Learn more: https://unlocked.microsoft.com/llms-nunavut/
